field: earth observation strategy and data infrastructure
public_contact_or_submission: public homepage with published strategy downloads
why_relevant: publishes the GEO In-situ Data Strategy and the Global Ecosystems Atlas; a ground-visible record of what the observation community is currently prioritising
notes: not a submission venue; use it to identify the current strategy documents before contacting GEO through the Get Involved page

public_contact_or_submission: public Contact Us page and public constituent-body events
why_relevant: hosts INFCOM, the Commission for Observation, Infrastructure and Information Systems, and publishes the Global Status of Multi-Hazard Early Warning Systems; a legitimate institutional entry point for observation-gap questions
notes: use the public contact and event routes; do not send unreleased claims expecting confidentiality

organization: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
why_relevant: archives data from more than 130 observing platforms; a public, checkable record of the observing system and its continuity problems
notes: site was mid-migration to the cloud at verification; some portals temporarily unavailable; use the contact-by-topic route

field: Earth system interactions, prediction, modelling and decision relevance
public_contact_or_submission: online submission via the journal submission system
why_relevant: interactive open-access journal explicitly soliciting work on interactions among atmosphere, cryosphere, hydrosphere, oceans, pedosphere, lithosphere, life and human activity, and on predictions and their impacts; recently published work on information loss in aggregation and on decision-relevant 1 km groundwater products
notes: an interactive public review process is a ground-visible venue; the journal has an explicit AI policy, check it before submitting LLM-assisted work

organization: Earth System Science Data (ESSD), EGU / Copernicus
field: original research data sets and observation records
public_contact_or_submission: online submission via the journal submission system
why_relevant: publishes original observation data sets of benefit to Earth system sciences, including station, gridded and flux records; the right venue for a characterised observation-gap record rather than a general argument
notes: public interactive review; data and code must be openly accessible; AI policy applies
